biological_replicate_idr.input_policy: Separate MACS3 BAMPE calls at p=0.01, same usable BAMs and genome size; signal.value ranking

genrich-native-p0.01.fragment_definition: SE aligned span; PE outer aligned span of two primary mates on same contig

duplicate_flag_fraction.definition: flag 0x400 / retained mapped primary read ends; not a PCR estimate

fragment_retention.definition: complete same-contig template spans / raw templates

fragments_FRiP_fixed.definition: any BED0 span overlap with fixed peaks / retained fragments; union prevents double counting

fragments_FRiP_own.definition: any BED0 span overlap with own peaks / retained fragments; union prevents double counting

organellar_fraction.definition: declared organellar mapped read ends / retained mapped primary read ends

peak_jaccard.definition: base-pair intersection / union versus frozen baseline intervals

read_ends_FRiP_fixed.definition: any BED0 span overlap with fixed peaks / retained read_ends; union prevents double counting

read_ends_FRiP_own.definition: any BED0 span overlap with own peaks / retained read_ends; union prevents double counting

read_retention.definition: primary mapped read ends / raw read ends

genrich-native-p0.01.scientific_policy: Additional caller diagnostic, not a production policy or QC decision
